title: Run bounded diagnostic captures from recipes
changes: Allow the existing bounded UI, audio, code, gameplay and graphics capture/report actions in typed recipes, preserving handler preflight, ordered terminal results and request-ledger recovery.
Document that report-specific resource limits and outputs are separate from the bounded recipe checkpoint and that cancellation does not erase an existing capture.
validation: Windows GNU runtime/test build and 31 focused Wine tests passed, including capture action ordering, lost-report response recovery without duplicate execution and existing recipe/control contracts.

An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter run using a stripped built runtime executed UI start, one frame, UI report and status in a recipe; exactly one report was produced, a second resume left the guest unchanged, protected inputs were unchanged and the window closed normally.
limitations: Only UI capture was tested end-to-end through a real session; other newly enabled capture types used a synthetic server. Interactive picker, native Windows, physical input, session restart and other action types remain open. The UI proof retains private session inputs as a named current proof.
